Sehat | Episode No: 1505
In today’s show, we will discuss:
Foamy Urine and Kidney Health: Can foamy urine be an early sign of kidney damage? When is it normal, and when should you be concerned? How does protein leakage from the kidneys cause foamy urine? Who is at a higher risk? Which tests, including the Urine ACR test, can help detect early kidney damage? Guest: Dr. B. Vijay Kiran, Medical Director, Asian Institute of Nephrology & Urology, Siliguri.
